incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired for svc=hosted-inference prod-eu - HIGH error-rate (5xx spike) across inference-prod-eu shards. PD incident: PD-4321. Auto-escalation policy started.

pd-bot: Page delivered to primary oncall <@Alex R> at 6161616161. No ack within 60s. Escalating to secondary <@Sam K>.

Alex R: seeing the bot. jumping in. any immediate customer impact?

Sam K: sorry mid-incident on another page, i got pd notif now. acked PD-4321.

pd-bot: <@Sam K> acknowledged PD-4321 at 6161616180. Escalation to manager will fire if no mitigation in 10m.

Maya L: quick check of observability - error-rate is up to ~18% on 3 nodes in inference-prod-eu-1, tail latency also spiking.

Alex R: logs show repeated OOM-ish GC patterns in model-worker-7, see snippet: ```
2026-03-15T02:43:12Z worker-7 ERROR runtime: allocation failure
2026-03-15T02:43:12Z worker-7 INFO gc: pause 2350ms
```

Maya L: agreed. also SLO alerts triggered on kv-cache misses - could be memory pressure causing eviction storms.

Alex R: trying immediate mitigation: scaling up dedicated pool by +2 replicas for prod-eu and setting fallback routing to prod-us-west. executing CLI now.

Sam K: can you add temporary request-rate limit per-client to reduce token amplification? i'll open the bridge and start throttling rules.

Alex R: running: `rctl scale --pool inference-prod-eu --add 2 --reason "OOM mitigation PD-4321"`

Oncall Rotation Bot: Manual override succeeded, 2 replicas added to pool inference-prod-eu at 6161616188.

Priya S: PD escalation to manager fired (no stable recovery within window). I'm on the bridge. tagging legal/comms? potential customer impact?

Alex R: putting highest-impact customers into read-only routing and sending FAQ to comms. early impact estimate: ~7% of requests saw 5xx over 10m window. prepping post for status.redwood.ai.

Sam K: enforced rate-limit rule for top 20 clients. reduced incoming qps by ~30%. error-rate trending down to 6% in the last 2m.

Maya L: cache eviction rate returned to normal, GC pauses reduced. metrics: error-rate -> 3.2% and tail p95 latency back to baseline after routing change.

Priya S: good. keep PD incident open until stable 30m. comms notified: @commops. prepare RCA notes: suspected memory leak + eviction cascade.

Alex R: creating quick runbook note in the incident doc and assigning postmortem to Sam + Maya. bridge link: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/PD-4321

Sam K: on it. will run heap dump from worker-7 and upload to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/PD-4321/heap-worker-7.hprof

incidentbot: PD-4321 status updated: acknowledged by <@Sam K>, manager escalated (<@Priya S>), mitigation actions applied (scale, rate-limit, routing), customers notified.

Alex R: thanks all. will monitor for 45m and then start rollback of temporary limits if stable. please post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
